jobs.title: Sacramento County, CA - Deputy Director, Airport Commercial Development
jobs.description:
The Sacramento County Department of Airports is seeking an accomplished airport business and commercial development leader to serve as Deputy Director, Airport Commercial Development
. This executive will help guide commercial growth across Sacramento International Airport, Mather Airport, Executive Airport, and Franklin Field during a period of significant investment and expansion, including the $1.4 billion SMForward capital program.

Reporting to the Assistant Airport Director, the Deputy Director will oversee air service and air cargo development, commercial real estate, concessions, leases, revenue generation, customer experience, public parking, communications, and the future consolidated rental car facility. Key priorities include expanding international air service, increasing non-aeronautical revenue, strengthening airline and industry relationships, and advancing innovative passenger and branding strategies.

The ideal candidate will be a collaborative, entrepreneurial, and highly self-directed leader with strong airport commercial development experience. Experience working in both the airport and airline sectors is particularly desirable.

Salary: $197,065 - $217,256 annually

Apply by October 15, 2026, at 5:00 p.m.
at www.saccountyjobs.net
. First-round interviews are anticipated in early November.

For additional information, contact:
Wesley Herman
at wherman@alliancerc.com or (562) 901-0769 ext. 337.

jobs.title: Director of Operations
jobs.description:
About JM Test Systems

JM Test Systems provides calibration, test and measurement equipment, and technical services across multiple business segments and service locations. We help customers in industrial, energy, manufacturing, and other demanding environments keep critical instruments accurate, compliant, and ready to perform.

Job Summary — The Opportunity

Our network of locations is where JM Test Systems delivers for customers every day, in our labs, on our rental floors, and in the field. As we grow, both organically and through acquisitions, we're looking for a Director of Operations to bring our locations together into one consistent, scalable operation.

In this role, you will restructure and standardize how our growing locations operate, integrate newly acquired businesses, and build the foundation that lets us scale, all while driving profitability, revenue growth, turnaround times, safety, and customer satisfaction. You'll partner with our Chief Revenue Officer, Director of Marketing, and division managers to grow market share, sharpen pricing and service offerings, and bring in the processes and technology that help our teams work smarter.

You'll thrive here if you're a strategic, data-driven leader who develops strong teams, stays close to customers, and has built consistency and scale across a growing, multi-location business.

Key Responsibilities & Outcomes

Standardize for scale. Restructure operations across our locations to create consistent processes, structures, and standards that support continued growth.
Integrate acquisitions. Lead the operational integration of newly acquired businesses, bringing their people, processes, and systems into the JM Test Systems way of working.
Drive financial performance. Deliver EBITDA and revenue to plan across all locations through smart pricing, expanded service offerings, sales strategies, and cost control.
Grow market share. Work with the CRO and Director of Marketing on digital strategy, new market segments, product category management, strategic partnerships, and brand visibility.
Delight customers. Improve customer satisfaction and loyalty through regular surveys, feedback, faster turnaround, and prompt issue resolution.
Make operations more efficient. Streamline processes, automate tasks, implement technology, and optimize resources to improve order fulfillment and calibration and repair turnaround times.
Lead a safety-first culture. Ensure every location meets safety programs, audits, and inspections, and stays compliant with industry regulations and company policies.
Build high-performing teams. Set clear goals, coach and develop leaders, recognize performance, and improve engagement and retention across the network.

What You Bring

Required: MBA or a similar advanced degree in business or a related field.
Required: Proven experience leading operations across multiple locations, with accountability for P&L, EBITDA, and revenue results.
Required: Track record of standardizing and scaling a growing multi-location business, including integrating acquisitions.
Required: Strong business and financial insight, with the ability to use data and market trends to guide pricing, service offerings, and strategy.
Required: Track record of improving efficiency, turnaround times, and customer satisfaction through process and technology, and of developing talent and building engaged teams.
Required: Excellent communication and relationship-building skills with customers, leaders, and teams at every level.
Preferred: Experience in rental, calibration, testing, or industrial services.

Why JM Test Systems?

This is a senior leadership role with a direct impact on how JM Test Systems grows. You'll work alongside our executive team, lead across a network of locations and service lines, and have the ownership to build the operating model that carries us through our next stage of growth.

Benefits

Medical, dental, and vision insurance
HSA with employer contribution
Paid time off and company holidays
401(k) retirement plan with company matching
Company-paid life insurance
Supplemental insurance policies
Training and development opportunities
Opportunities for continued growth within JM Test Systems

Equal Opportunity Employer

JM Test Systems is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Clinical Development Director
jobs.description:
Let’s build the future of medicine - together.

Remote| Full-time | $330K-$370K

YOUR ROLE

As a Clinical Development Director
at Enveda, you won’t be working on another me-too drug. You’ll be working on a first-in-class opportunity with broad potential across metabolism and autoimmune disease, and it's one of the most exciting bets in our pipeline. You will own the core clinical development plan, design the first-in-human program, and build the path that turns a novel mechanism into a potentially transformational medicine in two therapeutic areas. This is a critical leadership role on the Asset team, where you will have a significant impact on its direction and success while collaborating with some of the brightest minds in the industry.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Build the clinical development plan and first-in-human strategy from the ground up
Design the Phase 1 protocol: dose, endpoints, population, pharmacodynamic readouts, and the design nuance of testing across two therapeutic areas, plus the operational realism to make it run
Shape the translational and biomarker strategy that turns a preclinical mechanism into a credible human proof-of-mechanism readout
Support the path to IND and the early regulatory strategy behind it
Run Advisory Boards that produce decision-grade insight and genuinely change how we approach trial design and next steps
Build the KOL and site network ahead of the clinic, so we're ready to move when the study opens
Excite thought leaders, physicians, PIs, and patients about the opportunity in metabolism and autoimmune disease
Contribute to the broader platform narrative for investors and partners where scientific credibility is on the line

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

MD, with credentials that add actual and perceived credibility to the program
Live, warm global KOL and site network in autoimmune disease (metabolic disease as well is a plus)
Track record of taking assets into the clinic and landing non-trivial first-in-human and early-phase programs. Bonus points for at least one 'not just another X study' where design creativity was the unlock
First-hand experience designing and running early clinical development, particularly proof-of-mechanism studies in immune-mediated disease
Comfortable owning translational and pharmacodynamic strategy, not just trial logistics
Clinically creative and unlocked by clinical depth; strong strategic and scientific judgement
An undisputed champion for patients, someone willing to go to bat and change the paradigm, not just add another entry to it
The person colleagues call when they want a straight answer; well-regarded in the community in a substantive, not just social, way
Entrepreneurial by nature: comfortable with ambiguity, energized by building, motivated by impact over process
Ego-lite, Enveda culture: collaborative, direct, gets the work done without needing the spotlight

We hire for trajectory, not just credentials. If you meet most of the above and care deeply about this problem, we want to hear from you.

About Enveda

We're a clinical-stage, AI-enabled biotech discovering medicines four times faster than the industry standard. We recently raised $311M in a Series E. Forbes named us one of America's Best Startup Employers . Newsweek recognized us as a Top 100 Most Loved Workplace . We're building something rare - and we're just getting started.

Benefits (Starting Day 1):
Medical, dental, and vision covered at 90%, 401(k) with company match, flexible PTO and a company-wide weeklong recharge break, adoption assistance

Our Process
: We move fast and respect your time. Typically: a recruiter screen → hiring manager conversation → work sample, technical interview, & culture interview.

Our Values
: Curiosity | Agency | Journey | Charity | Unity

Enveda is protecting Job Seekers

We care deeply about creating a safe, respectful experience for every applicant, so we wanted to share a few guidelines to help you spot anything that doesn’t feel right.

You’ll always meet real Enveda team members through video or in-person conversations before receiving an offer
All communication from us will come from an @enveda.com or @envedabio.com email address
We’ll never ask you to purchase equipment, send money, or share sensitive banking details as part of any step in our recruiting process

If something feels off or you’re unsure whether a message is truly from Enveda, please reach out at anytime at recruiting@enveda.com.

At Enveda, we’re building a place where everyone can do the best work of their life. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity in all its forms. Apply now and join a team committed to shaping the future of drug discovery.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Communications
jobs.description:
Come join our Communications team

Our Communications team is committed to sharpening how the market understands Karat; we build the channels, campaigns, and executive presence that position Karat as the definitive measure of talent.

What you will do

As Senior Director, Communications at Karat, you will own the company's entire communications function, spanning external, internal, executive, and crisis communications, and serve as a trusted advisor to the CEO and leadership team.

Set and evolve Karat's integrated communications strategy, advising the CEO and leadership team on narrative, messaging, timing, and stakeholder impact.
Own media relations end-to-end, building proactive relationships with journalists and producers across business, technology, workplace, and trade press.
Develop integrated campaigns with Product Marketing and Demand Generation that turn thought leadership, research, and product milestones into stories that break through.
Build and run the CEO's platform across social, the company blog, earned media, and speaking opportunities, including the executive editorial calendar.
Lead internal and executive communications for major company moments, keeping employee-facing and external narratives aligned.
Guide crisis and issues communications, coordinating response across Legal, People, Sales, and Marketing as needed.
Manage our PR agency and other communications partners to measurable outcomes, tracking KPIs across earned media, executive visibility, and employee understanding.

The experience you will bring

15+ years of progressive communications experience spanning media relations, corporate, executive, and internal/change communications
Significant in-house experience at a high-growth technology or B2B company navigating rapid growth
A track record of building journalist relationships and securing high-quality earned coverage
Demonstrated success developing narratives and campaigns that connect strategy, product, and industry conversation
Experience building executive platforms and coaching executives for media, speaking engagements, and high-stakes moments
Exceptional writing and editorial judgment, from executive social content to all-hands remarks
Experience guiding communications through periods of growth or high-stakes change, with discretion and sound judgment
Experience managing PR agencies or communications partners to measurable outcomes
Fluency in how AI is reshaping hiring, talent assessment, and workforce planning, a plus

.
